title: get all repositories with rule counts
description: Test the GET /api/repos endpoint to ensure it returns a 200 status with a list of repositories including their metadata and rule counts. Verify behavior when no repositories are tracked and when the server encounters an internal error.

title: list rules with filters and search
description: Test the GET /api/rules endpoint with required repo_id and optional filters category, severity, is_active, and search. Verify it returns 200 with filtered RuleListItem[]. Also test 400 response when repo_id is missing.

title: get single rule detail by slug
description: Test the GET /api/rules/{slug} endpoint to retrieve full rule details including decorator and linter source. Verify 200 response for existing rules and 404 for nonexistent slugs.

title: get rule provenance information
description: Test the GET /api/rules/{slug}/provenance endpoint to retrieve provenance data including PR references, authors, diffs, and file paths. Verify 200 for existing rules and 404 for nonexistent rules.

title: trigger enforcer generation for rule
description: Test the POST /api/rules/{slug}/generate-enforcer endpoint to start enforcer generation. Verify 200 with job_id on success, 400 if rule lacks negative_example, 409 if generation already in progress, and 404 if rule not found.

title: list enforcers optionally by repo
description: Test the GET /api/enforcers endpoint to list all enforcer scripts, optionally filtered by repo_id. Verify 200 response with EnforcerListItem[].

title: get enforcer detail for rule
description: Test the GET /api/rules/{slug}/enforcer endpoint to retrieve enforcer details including source, tests, and traces. Verify 200 for existing enforcers and 404 if rule or enforcer not found.

title: submit video generation task for rule
description: Test the POST /api/rules/{slug}/generate-video endpoint to submit a video generation request with optional prompt. Verify 200 with task_id on success and 404 if rule not found.

title: poll video generation task status
description: Test the GET /api/video/{task_id} endpoint to poll the status of a video generation task. Verify 200 with status 'processing', 'completed' with video URL, or 'failed' with error details.

title: check external service credentials status
description: Test the GET /api/credentials/status endpoint to verify connectivity status for AWS Bedrock, Datadog, and GitHub integrations. Verify 200 with success or partial failure statuses and 500 on subsystem errors.
